ideas.title: Stack Cars for Cash
ideas.hook: Run a scrapyard crane. Drop wrecked cars onto one wobbly tower, and every metre of height pays out until the whole pile crashes down.
core_loop: Buy wrecks at the gate auction
Swing them into place with the crane
Cash out height before the tower topples
Upgrade the crane, magnets and the yard's car index
ideas.twist: Each car has real weight and shape: a bus is a great base, a scooter is a wobbly cap, and a perfect stack of one model unlocks its golden version.
monetization: Wind shield (storage of one saved stack)
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim jumped from 1.29 to 2.11 momentum this week (+0.82), led by Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (44.3K CCU) and 🧪Realistic Phone Drop Test (9.5K). Vehicle Sim is up 0.68 and the Vehicles theme sits at 1.58 (+0.40) with [🎃] Bike Universe at 52.9K.
ideas.differentiator: Car crash games are about smashing; this one rewards careful building, so the crash is the payoff for greed rather than the whole game.

ideas.title: +1 Spell Range
ideas.hook: Flick your wand and every cast gains +1 range. Fire a fireball across the kingdom and hatch the familiar egg wherever it lands.
core_loop: Cast at the practice dummy for +1 range each flick
Launch a full-power spell down the valley
Hatch the familiar egg in the zone it lands in
Equip familiars that multiply range gain
ideas.twist: Spells bounce off castle walls and dragons, so a lucky ricochet can carry a weak wizard into the next zone.
retention: Rebirth into a new wizard rank
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula rose 0.42 this week to 2.27 and +1 stat per action is at 2.11 (+0.39), with [🌍WORLD 2] +1 Venom Evolution (25.3K) and [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping (24.3K) leading. Fantasy / medieval is up 0.65 to 1.48 with only [✍️]DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA (5.6K) using spells.
ideas.differentiator: Stone Skipping launches a fixed object; here the spell itself is the thing you level, and ricochets add a skill shot to the grind.

ideas.title: Draw Beats for Fans
ideas.hook: Paint on a glowing grid and your drawing plays as a song. Fans line up at your studio, and catchy drawings sell out.
core_loop: Paint notes on the canvas with coloured brushes
Play the track to the fan queue
Sell copies and earn fans
Unlock new instruments as paint colours
ideas.twist: Fans react live: a smiley face plays happy, a jagged scribble plays metal, and a viral track gets copied by NPC rivals across the map.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is the top rising mechanic at 2.32 (up 0.09) with [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] (41.4K) and Backseat Rally (41.1K). Sell / run a shop is up 0.42 to 2.26 behind 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (80.0K). Music / dance holds steady at 1.34 with +1 Dance Battle Evolution at 12.9K.
ideas.differentiator: Music games test timing; here you create the song with a brush, so every player's shop sounds different.

ideas.title: Fix Robots for Cash
ideas.hook: Run a late-night robot repair shop. Most customers just need a new arm. Some are hiding something, and you have to spot them before closing time.
core_loop: Take a broken robot from the counter
Swap parts, solder wires and test it
Get paid, or notice the glitch that marks a rogue bot
Survive the night if you let a rogue one through
ideas.twist: Rogue robots copy a normal customer exactly except one tiny detail, so repair skill and spotting the anomaly use the same close look.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 0.42 to 2.26, led by 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (80.0K) and Fix My Phone! (12.3K), and interior maps are at 1.92. Robots / mechs is a small but fast riser (2.38, +0.81) with Steel Fighters (32.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Repair games are calm and anomaly games are scary; this blends them so the repair is how you find the threat.

ideas.title: +1 Cash Per Step
ideas.hook: Every step you take adds +1 cash to a pile under your feet. Keep walking and your own money becomes a tower you can climb to rich-only islands.
core_loop: Walk to earn +1 cash per step
Spend cash to raise your pile
Climb to the next floating island
Collect rare bills that boost step value
ideas.twist: Other players can walk on your pile, so a big tower becomes a shared ladder and you earn a tip every time someone uses it.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is the strongest theme at 2.05 (up 0.10) across 41 new games, led by Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 (61.3K) and +1 Money Per Click 💸 (13.5K). The "+1 ___" formula rose 0.42 to 2.27 and obby climbing pairs well with tycoons (65K CCU in new games).
ideas.differentiator: Climb games give you a fixed tower; here you build the climb out of your own earnings, and other players can use it.

ideas.title: Catch Citizens for Fame
ideas.hook: You are the city's newest hero. Buildings collapse, cars fly and ragdoll citizens fall from the sky, and every one you catch adds fame.
core_loop: Patrol the city for disaster alerts
Fly or wall-run to the falling citizens
Catch them before they hit the ground for +1 fame
Spend fame on flight speed, capes and bigger nets
ideas.twist: Citizens are physics ragdolls, so catches can bounce, chain into each other and pile up in silly ways that pay bonus fame.
ideas.why_now: Job / shift is at 1.13 (up 0.33) and Physics Sim jumped 0.82 to 2.11 behind Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (44.3K). Superheroes / powers is at 1.54 (up 0.22) with Superhero Arena at 13.5K, mostly fighting games.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games on Roblox are almost all combat; this one is a rescue job where the ragdoll physics are the comedy.

ideas.title: Night Bus [Anomaly]
ideas.hook: Drive the last bus route of the night. Check every passenger's ticket and face, and keep anything wrong off your bus.
core_loop: Drive to the next stop on time
Inspect passengers before letting them on
Report anomalies or kick them off
Survive to the depot and unlock the next route
ideas.twist: Anomalies change the route itself: a stop that wasn't there, a road that loops, a passenger who boarded twice.
ideas.why_now: Vehicle Sim is up 0.68 to 1.69 and Story is up 0.64 to 1.34, with [UPD] Something is Wrong With My Dog... (15.2K) leading. Anomaly shifts keep landing: 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (80.0K) and Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) (20.5K).
inspired_by: [UPD] Something is Wrong With My Dog...
ideas.differentiator: Bus games are calm driving sims; this adds the anomaly-spotting loop that is pulling the biggest new survival hits.

ideas.title: Build a Spell Tower
ideas.hook: Every wizard builds their own tower one magic floor at a time. Other players race to climb it, and the top floor guards your treasure.
core_loop: Earn mana from your tower floors
Buy new floors: lava stairs, moving books, ghost bridges
Climb rival towers for their top-floor loot
Collect rare floor blueprints
ideas.twist: Each floor is both a money maker and an obstacle, so a harder tower earns less but is safer from raiders.
ideas.why_now: Obby / climb / jump is at 1.16 across 34 new games, and the obby + tycoon pair already holds 65K CCU in new games led by Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 (61.3K). Fantasy / medieval rose 0.65 to 1.48 with [🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense (9.0K) and Pixel Lineage [🎃Spear Class + Dragon Race] (6.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Tower obbies are built by the developer; here players design the obstacles and the climb is a raid on someone else's base.

ideas.title: Freeze Lava for Gems
ideas.hook: A volcano spills lava across the island. Tap to blast it with ice and every frozen chunk cracks open with gems or a fire pet inside.
core_loop: Tap to spray ice on the flowing lava
Freeze chunks before they cool on their own
Crack chunks for gems and pet eggs
Upgrade your ice blaster to reach hotter zones
ideas.twist: Lava flows change every few minutes, so the best gems appear where the flow is fastest and most dangerous.
ideas.why_now: Clicker / tap is up 0.50 this week to 1.17, led by Cat Battles 🐾 (34.8K) and Tap Simulator REBORN. Ice / fire / elements holds at 1.27 with Firefighting Sim 🚒 (11.9K) and [🎃]Melt All The Ice!🧊 (3.0K) showing elemental tasks work.
ideas.differentiator: Melt games remove ice; this flips it so you create ice to tame a moving threat, which keeps tapping active instead of idle.

ideas.title: Drop Eggs for Pets
ideas.hook: Draw a contraption around your egg, carry it up the tower and drop it. If it survives the fall, it hatches, and higher drops hatch rarer pets.
core_loop: Draw a parachute, bubble or spring frame around the egg
Climb to a drop floor
Drop it and watch the physics
Hatch survivors and use pets to unlock higher floors
ideas.twist: Every drawn shape behaves differently, so friends share and copy designs that survive the 1000-metre drop.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Eggs is the top open gap (7.89). Physics Sim rose 0.82 to 2.11 and 🧪Realistic Phone Drop Test (9.5K) shows drop tests pull players, while [🎃] Fake an Egg (32.6K) keeps eggs hot.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games decorate or steal eggs; here you protect one with your own drawing, so the hatch is earned by a physics puzzle.
